entry_item.definition: (fr. S.); T. bskal par bskal dus; S. kalpa. Time with reference to cosmic ages, eon. See Pt.I under γalab and ED 172.

example.definition: hjig (pahi) bskal (pa); S. samvartakalpa. Eon of destruction (of the world). ED540a.
T. mehi bskal pa, mes hjig pa; S. tejahsamvartani. The period during which the universe will be destroyed by fire.
T. bskal par chen po,bskal chen; S. maha -kalpa. The great period, the duration of the world from its begimiing to its destruction.
T. bskal bzang po; S. bhadra-kalpa. A good kalpa, a kalpa during which five Bus. Appear successively.
T. hchags bskal pa; S. vivarta-kalpa. The period of regeneration.
T. stong pahi bskal pa; S. çūnya-kalpa. An empty kalpa, an eon in which no Bu. appears.
